observations: body L1-L9: Schiaparelli's addition begun on p. 251 goes on; in L9 a heavy bracket closes it, after a dash of 10.0 pt. L3-L4 reword p. 77, L25-L27 with «zenith» for «medii Caeli».

body L2, L6, L13-L15, L26-L27: «al–Battānī» and «al–Farghānī» have long dashes (5.3 to 5.4 pt); in L14-L15 «al–Farghānī» is divided at its dash, which is printed at the end of L14 and again at the beginning of L15 (5.3 and 5.4 pt). The second «al–Battānī» of L14 is printed without letter-spacing; a stroke over the first a of «al–Battānī» (L27) is not transcribed.

body L10: the dash after «c)» measures 10.0 pt, that of «32–34» 5.9 pt. The lines cited are p. 77, L32-L34: «Parallaxis etiam est in Venere et Mercurio sensibilis, sed magis in Mercurio ... in perigeo, quo tempore eius parallaxis aequat parallaxim Lunae in apogeo».
body L12, L17, L33, L36: a stroke over the first a of «apogeae», a speck under the s of «sensu», a speck over the e of «Sole» and one after «Igitur» are not transcribed.
body L21: the comma after «reiecerint» prints low; the dash of «167–69» measures 5.4 pt.
body L23-L24: Ptolemy puts the Sun 1210 radii of the Earth from it; the parallax of a body at that distance on the horizon is arcsin(1/1210) = 2′ 50.5″, his 2′ 51″.
body L31-L32: «114-» and «-115» are divided at the hyphen, which is printed at the end of L31 and again at the beginning of L32 (2.9 and 2.8 pt).

body L35-L38: with the radius of the eccentric 60ᵖ, the epicycle 43ᵖ 10′ and the eccentricity 1ᵖ 15′ (Ptolemy's Venus), the greatest distance of Venus is 60 + 1;15 + 43;10 = 104ᵖ 25′ and the least 60 − 1;15 − 43;10 = 15ᵖ 35′, «amplius 104ᵖ» and «minus 16ᵖ». The argument goes on to p. 253.
notes_left L2-L3, notes_right L1: the hyphens at the ends of «alio-» and «indu-» print short (1.6 and 1.8 pt); a low stroke after «inventum),» is not transcribed.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
